test-code.description: a package-private method is not reported
a public method is not reported
an interface method is implicitly public and is not reported
a private interface method is reported
a private constructor is not reported: constructors are out of scope
a protected constructor is not reported
a protected override is not reported: visibility is fixed by the supertype
a protected method without Override is reported
a private static method is left to StaticMethodsModifyStaticState
a private static method in a utility class is reported by neither rule
a protected method with a subclass in the same file is still reported
suppression is available for a genuine extension point
an unrelated annotation does not exempt a private method
several hidden methods in one class are each reported
